messages.text: The Movember client was wondering if the publisher partners had given any direct, positive soundbites or feedback off the back of Confession Box. Know we have standout comments on live content but they're wondering if any contacts from the publishers themselves said anything. Feel like there were a few saying how well it had done / how much they loved the campaign?

messages.text:
Hey Luke! Yeah the IJB guys thought this was a really fun campaign to be on and an important one for men's mental health. They particularly think the first episode was the strongest which was evident in the performance of the first episode. 

As for Common, pretty similar really, I can get more quotes if you need it?
